_meta.purpose: Structured summary of the expanded Google Colab evaluation run (source: AgriMind-ML-Evaluation.zip). This is ADDITIONAL evidence layered on top of, not a replacement for, the original 280-image evaluation in ml_evaluation_report.json / ml_evaluation_strict7_classes.json.
_meta.model_evaluated: apps/api/models/agrimind_plant_disease_model.keras -- unchanged, this is V1, nothing was retrained or modified
_meta.raw_source_files: Full per-image CSVs are in the AgriMind-ML-Evaluation.zip deliverable (01_Full_5_Crop_Evaluation/, 02_Error_Analysis/, 03_Full_Dataset_Test/, 04_PlantVillage_250_Test/, 05_SAGE_Real_World/, 06_SAGE_Sugarcane_OOD/) and are not checked into this docs/ folder -- the figures below were computed directly from those CSVs.
_meta.held_out_status_unchanged: None of the evaluations below resolve the original-training-data provenance question. Whether any of this evaluation imagery overlaps with whatever data originally trained the model remains UNKNOWN, exactly as for the original 280-image evaluation.

A_full_five_crop_diseases_dataset.classes_covered: All 17 in-taxonomy classes with real ground truth present in this dataset (Background___Non_Plant never appears as a true label here)
A_full_five_crop_diseases_dataset.note: Sugarcane_generic_classes = the model's 3 non-crop-prefixed classes (Healthy, Bacterial Blight, Red Rot), which is all the sugarcane-adjacent coverage this model has; see section E for real sugarcane disease OOD behavior.
notable_weak_classes: Rice___Leaf_Blast (54.0% recall, largest confusion with Rice___Healthy and Rice___Brown_Spot)
Corn___Gray_Leaf_Spot (76.0% accuracy, dominant bidirectional confusion with Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight)
A_full_five_crop_diseases_dataset.training_data_overlap: UNKNOWN -- images sourced from a public Kaggle dataset per the recorded image_path column; no evidence either way on overlap with this model's original (unrecoverable) training data.

B_plantvillage_250_image_evaluation.classes_covered: 7 classes: Corn___Common_Rust, Corn___Gray_Leaf_Spot, Corn___Healthy, Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight, Potato___Early_Blight, Potato___Healthy, Potato___Late_Blight
B_plantvillage_250_image_evaluation.relationship_to_prior_280_image_evaluati: THIS IS A DIFFERENT, SEPARATE, NEWER RUN -- not a re-statement or correction of the original 92.86%/280-image figure in ml_evaluation_report.md. Same 7-class scope, different image sample (250 vs 280 images), different result (96.0% vs 92.86%). Both figures should be reported and neither should be treated as superseding the other -- they are two independent data points on the same 7-class scope, both subject to the same unresolved train/test-overlap caveat.

C_2265_image_external_dataset.reason_invalid: Both ground-truth labels present in this dataset (Corn_(Maize)___Leaf_Spot and Corn_(Maize)___Maize_Streak_Virus) are OUTSIDE the model's 18-class taxonomy. There is no correct answer the model could have given for any of these 2,265 images.
C_2265_image_external_dataset.do_not_report_as: 0% accuracy -- this framing is misleading because the task itself was impossible under this model's taxonomy
C_2265_image_external_dataset.observed_behavior: The model does not abstain when shown genuinely off-taxonomy plant disease images. Predictions scattered across many known classes (Wheat___Healthy 656x, Corn___Healthy 408x, Wheat___Brown_Rust 359x, and 15 other classes) at a relatively high average confidence (0.78, up to 0.9999).

D_sage_real_world_matched_evaluation.sample_note: Referred to as "51" in the source filename; 46 rows of usable data are present in the delivered CSV.
D_sage_real_world_matched_evaluation.classes_covered: In-taxonomy only: Corn (Common_Rust, Gray_Leaf_Spot, Northern_Leaf_Blight), Potato (Early_Blight, Late_Blight), Rice (Brown_Spot)
D_sage_real_world_matched_evaluation.significance: Small sample, but the only evaluation sourced from diverse real-world image origins (Bugwood, LeafNet, CDDM, New_Plant_Di -- not single-source lab photography like PlantVillage). Accuracy drops sharply versus the lab-image evaluations (A and B above), and several errors occur at >99% confidence.
D_sage_real_world_matched_evaluation.caveat: Small-N (46 images) -- treat as directional evidence of a lab-to-real-world generalization gap, not a precise accuracy figure.

E_sage_sugarcane_ood.reason_invalid: 17 distinct real sugarcane disease labels tested (Yellow_Spot, Grassy_Shoot, Sett_Rot, Banded_Chlorosis, Pokkah_Boeng, Sugarcane_Mosaic_Virus, Leaf_Scald, Brown_Rust, Brown_Spot, Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv, Yellow_Leaf, Eye_Spot, Common_Rust, Dried_Leaves, Leaf_Mosaic_Virus, Red_Spot, Smut), none of which map cleanly onto the model's only sugarcane-adjacent classes (generic Healthy / Bacterial Blight / Red Rot).
E_sage_sugarcane_ood.key_finding: 45% of these unsupported-class images still passed the model's 68% confidence gate, meaning the existing confidence threshold does not reliably reject this class of out-of-taxonomy input.
E_sage_sugarcane_ood.do_not_report_as: an accuracy test -- there is no valid ground-truth label for any of these images under the current 18-class taxonomy

error_analysis_findings.high_confidence_wrong_predictions_csv_co: docs note: 02_Error_Analysis/high_confidence_wrong_predictions.csv in the delivered evaluation package is NOT filtered to a high-confidence subset. It contains the same 1,672 rows as all_wrong_predictions.csv (confidence range 22.0%-99.998%), sorted by confidence descending. Treat it as 'all wrong predictions, sorted by confidence' when using it, not as a pre-filtered high-confidence-only sample.
error_analysis_findings.corn_gray_leaf_spot_vs_northern_leaf_bli: Confirmed recurring bidirectional confusion, consistent with the original 280-image evaluation: 112 Gray_Leaf_Spot images predicted as Northern_Leaf_Blight, 104 Northern_Leaf_Blight images predicted as Gray_Leaf_Spot, in the 13,324-image test alone.
error_analysis_findings.confidence_is_not_calibrated: Across every evaluation set checked (13,324-image, SAGE real-world, SAGE sugarcane OOD), correct and incorrect predictions have substantially overlapping confidence ranges, and multiple wrong predictions exceed 99% confidence. Confidence should not be treated as a calibrated probability of correctness.
error_analysis_findings.ood_rejection_remains_unreliable: Three independent pieces of evidence now show the model does not reliably reject out-of-taxonomy input: (1) the original synthetic-noise probe (ml_probe_results.json), (2) the 2,265-image off-taxonomy Corn disease test (section C), (3) the 110-image off-taxonomy Sugarcane disease test (section E). No threshold-based fix has been evidence-backed.
